identity: NiceGUI Base current Reference Explorer: governed UI authority gallery for enterprise engineering work; discover intent-first, inspect real registered specimens, then use the canonical implementation.

characterization.typography: Compact, tokenized hierarchy using high-contrast page titles, medium-weight section labels, secondary explanatory copy and tabular numerals for measurements.
characterization.density: Information-dense but segmented by meaningful sections, cards, filters and tables; density is a controllable table preference (Comfort/Compact/Dense).
characterization.hierarchy: Persistent navigation anchors the standard; page header names the workspace; scan-first cards and live examples separate overview from deep inspection.
characterization.spacing_rhythm: Design tokens govern page gutters, control gaps and section spacing; wide canvases use full available width beside the governed shell.
characterization.surfaces: Quiet neutral surfaces with restrained borders, rounded containers and selective elevation for transient overlays.
characterization.color: Semantic status color is localized to warnings/alerts/success and chart series; light/dark themes inherit from shared tokens.
characterization.icons: Small line icons on actions and controls, paired with labels or accessible names.
characterization.specimens: Use canonical production renderers with synthetic engineering fixtures; specimen context and live detail authority stay visible.
characterization.motion: Short state transitions; reduced-motion preference is supported by current shell/design authority.
characterization.data_density: Tables and chart data are first-class task surfaces with selectable, filterable, inspectable records; charts pair visible summary with a data inspection path.
characterization.content_tone: Plain engineering language that names entities, measurements, ownership, status, uncertainty and synthetic/reference scope.
characterization.responsive_composition: Same task identity recomposes into single-column content and a toggleable mobile navigation drawer; no narrow outer canvas wrapper.
characterization.shell_navigation: Navigation groups capabilities by intent/work family and remains a stable context across detail routes.

preservation_laws: Do not redesign approved identity; preserve the current shell, semantic tokens, production renderer, fixture identity and interaction contracts.
Treat current screenshot differences as comparison evidence, not a visual equality target.
Retain the responsive hidden sidebar behavior; framework version identity is run-level, not per screenshot.
No beauty score; findings remain task- and clause-scoped.
